question: which division goes to which position

addresses.name: CAIUnit_FillLinePositions
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_FillLinePositions(CAIUnit* agent, CList* positions, void* positionMap, int lineCount, int* alliedSoilBudget)
addresses.comment: **The line: divides the line count among the positions and marches committed divisions (+0x12C) into them.** 0x4C8EE0 to the `ret 0x14` at 0x4CA9BD (0x4CA9C0 abuts with no padding - trap 2). Records are the 0x1C CAIProvinceRecord. (A) small fronts: front provinces (+0xC0) whose area holds <= 3 provinces and fewer than 5 enemy land units, and that a committed division stands or heads in. (B) per position in a friendly-controlled province: have and standing zeroed; a province whose only front neighbour is a small front gets want = -1000 (left out); else cap = CAIUnit_GetPositionCap, want = trunc(lineCount x score / ops_area_score_total +0x34C) capped at cap, the remainders carried (0 where score < 1.0 and the total >= 1.0). (C) CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(+0x12C, divisions only, allies too). (D) Nothing given: every position wants 1, or 2 where its province's units have a CUnit +0xC0 above 0. Else while the carry > 0.1, the position with the least want (+100 where want + 1 would pass cap, first of equals) gets one. Then where want > trunc(3.5 x cap) and the province's supplies (+0x164) are nought or its supply need (+0x24C) is at least five times them, want is cut to that and the excess handed to the other positions up to their own 3.5 x cap. (E) each committed division not in a garrison (+0x2C9) and not airborne (CArmy +0x2FC == 8) while air transports exist: d = CUnit_GetPendingDestinationProvince (0x49B010). **With no d**, d = the province it stands in. **With d held by an enemy** (at war by +0xE28[controller]->+0x20, REB on either side, or an undeclared war covering it): the division is **passed over** when its path (+0x140) has fewer than 2 provinces - an attack on a neighbour is left to run - or when d's area (+0x2B4) is no real area (slot 0) or holds 3 provinces or fewer (+0x2C); otherwise it goes on below. **With d not an enemy's**: where it is not retreating (+0x158), holds ground (CUnit::IsHoldingGround) and d is not its own depot, MoveUnit(next step, or d when the path has one province, 0, 1, 1, 0) and the pass counts as having moved - and it **goes on below** all the same (0x8C9C62 falls through to 0x8C9C66). Below: it **stays** when d is a position whose want (+0xC) is above nought and whose standing (+0x14) is within its cap (+0x18) - not its have against its want - and, where d is a target-area province (+0x1CC), only while d is beside a hostile-route province (+0x1BC) (0x8C9C66-0x8C9DCF). **Otherwise it moves only where CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, 0, strict, 0) allows it** (0x8C9DD5-0x8C9DFA, refused -> the per-unit continue at 0x8CA2B7), strict being the agent's own unit's (+0x64) oob_level (+0x1F4) other than 0 - every agent below a theatre - and the battle side not asked, so a division defending a battle is not held by the battle; then it goes to the position (have < cap) best by have/want x 100 (+ the excess over 1 again), at war x the distance and (have/want + 0.1), x 0.66 where a land battle is on, x 0.66 at a depot, x 0.66 beside a hostile-route province, less 50 x the unit's defensive terrain modifier there (slot 89, GetUnitTerrainModifier(province, unit, false)), that it can reach (CMapProvince::CanUnitReach); failing one, to a second-ring province (+0xA0) picked by a MT19937 seeded with the unit's id. (F) each position still short pulls the division best by squared map distance x 16 + dig-in/100 + attack delay/1000 - 100 x its terrain modifier here (x 0.25 where its own position wants none, else + 100 x its terrain modifier where it is bound), able to reach and leave. **The pull's candidates** (0x8CA387-0x8CA4F3): not retreating, not a garrison, standing somewhere; d = 0x89AF00 (a destination, not read) or where it stands; where d is its own depot (+0x48 == +0xD0), not one 0x8AF4E0 answers true for (not read); with the allied-soil budget spent, not one CAIUnit_IsMoveFromHomeAreaToAlliedSoil (0x4C77C0) refuses; not airborne while air transports exist; not one holding ground (CUnit::IsHoldingGround) whose own province is a position that wants divisions - the map looked up through 0x8DCF30 is the function's third argument, positionMap, keyed by the unit's province (+0x130), and the test is the record's want (+0xC) above 0; and **not one whose d is held by a country it is at war with (CCountry::IsEnemy, 0x42F210) and lies beside the province it stands in, by any edge** - an attack under way. **The pull's fuller test** (0x8CA2C7-0x8CA74A): for the short position T, notDepot = 0 where T's province is its own depot (+0x48 == +0xD0), else 1, and T fill = (T.have + notDepot) / T.want in single precision. For each candidate, D = the position record of its d (null where d is no position); count = D.standing (+0x14) where the unit stands at d, else D.have (+0x10); the candidate is **taken without the test** where D is null, D.want <= 0, or (it does not stand at d, T.standing < 1 and it stands at T). Otherwise k = 0 where notDepot is 0, else 1 where T.have != 0 or count <= 1, else 0; and it is **passed over unless (count - k) / D.want > T fill**. Past that, where the agent +0x364 is set, the plan's stance (+0x64 -> +0x208) is below 2 and count <= D.want, it is passed over unless T is its own province's neighbour or a neighbour's neighbour - the edges of the province it stands in (+0xD4 -> +0x90, 0x14 a record), kind 3 skipped, each neighbour needing its +0x22 and +0x13D bytes set. The score is then x 0.25 where D.want < 1 - **D null included** - else + 100 x the unit's terrain modifier at d. **The best is kept by strict < and must pass CanUnitReach(T, unit, 1, 1) and CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, 0, the agent's own unit's (+0x64) oob_level (+0x1F4) != 0, 0)**; once chosen: D.have - 1 and D.standing - 1 where D's province is where it stands (0x8CA8F1-0x8CA91D), 0x8C78E0(agent, T, unit, alliedSoilBudget) (not read), MoveUnit(unit, T, 0, 1, 1, 0), T.have + 1 and T.standing + 1 where T is where it stands, and the pull repeats while T.have < T.want. None left -> CAIUnit_SendReservesToPosition. Every move is CEU3AI::MoveUnit(unit, province, 0, safe, very safe). See FINDINGS-moving.md, sections A.4, A.4b and A.4e. **On the listing, 2026-11-10: the carry leaves out a position scoring under 1.0 where the scores come to 1.0 or more, as the share does** (0x8C9480). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 16. **Both halves read on the listing, 2026-11-10.** The send walks the positions with a want and under their cap in list order: one where the division stands is taken at once, unless the division is bound for a target province away from the hostile routes, when only positions beside one are looked at. The key: have/want x 100, plus (have/want - 1) x 100 above 1; at war instead the distance **from where it is bound** x (have/want + 0.1), x 0.66 for a land battle there; then less 50 x the terrain figure; then x 0.66 at a depot and x 0.66 beside a hostile route, all in single precision, from 1000000.0. The chosen is counted (the old record -1, standing too where it stood there; the new +1) and sent whatever MoveUnit answers. The pull's fill of the short position is worked out **once**, before its loop, and does not move as divisions are pulled to it; a candidate bound for its own depot under a blocking order (UnitHasBlockingOrder) is passed over. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 17.
